n: A short, gentle psalm of humility attributed to David. His heart isn’t proud, his eyes don’t look down on others, and he doesn’t obsess over matters too lofty for him.
He has calmed and quieted his soul like a weaned child resting on its mother — no longer fussing for milk, simply content to be near her. Mature trust is peaceful.
He invites all Israel to share this quiet hope in the Lord, now and forever.

f.w: Let Israel hope in the LORD
